feed.title: The Long Road to Bitcoin Payments

entry.title: The Long Road to Bitcoin Payments
entry.summary:
Ensuring transparency in payment processes is critical for retaining new users in digital wallet platforms. Users frequently face uncertainty regarding whether their transactions are being processed on-chain or via the Lightning Network, which leads to confusion about associated fees and transaction times. This lack of clarity can create a negative first impression, prompting users to disengage from making further payments and revert to simply holding their assets.
Improving user experience involves implementing straightforward solutions such as clearly labeling the method of payment, displaying fees prominently before the confirmation stage, and providing comprehensive recovery instructions that include guidance specific to Lightning funds. While these measures may seem minor compared to ambitious product features, they play a vital role in reducing friction during a user's initial interactions with the platform. By making the process of sending a first payment predictable and understandable, platforms can significantly improve early retention rates, even if these changes do not directly generate demand.
